# Releases
## react-live@5.0.1

### Patch Changes

- [#416](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/react-live/pull/416)
[`b8bf7a0`](https://github.com/FormidableLabs/react-live/commit/b8bf7a08306623b2aeed67526b1c5edac13aaa04)
